source.name: FOR SOCCER – 2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors
source.quote: Houston Dynamo FC MD Anderson Cancer Center Healthcare
source.note: Table row (quote spans the team / jersey partner / category cells). The club's own releases name MD Anderson as front-of-kit sponsor on the primary Season 20 kit (Feb 13, 2025, https://www.houstondynamofc.com/news/houston-dynamo-fc-launch-season-20-kit) and on the 2026 Mission Control alternate (Feb 11, 2026, https://www.houstondynamofc.com/news/houston-dynamo-fc-launch-mission-control-kit-inspired-by-houston-s-pioneering-spirit-in-space-exploration).

source.name: SportsLogos.Net – 'MLS to Allow Back-of-Jersey Ads Starting After 2026 All-Star Break'
source.quote: All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.

summary: The orange Season 20 primary kit, worn since 2025, with the club's new Mission Control alternate joining it for 2026-27. MD Anderson Cancer Center is on the front of both; the league-wide Apple TV patch is on the left sleeve and the club has no right-sleeve sponsor in 2026.
